Privacy Policy

Effective Date: September 2026

The Park Blueprint operates as an independent educational travel resource and park tracker platform.

1. YouTube & Third-Party API Services

This application uses YouTube API Services to display educational park videos. By using this feature, users agree to be bound by the YouTube Terms of Service and the Google Privacy Policy.

2. Data Collection

We do not sell personal data. Activity logs and visit entries submitted through the site are stored securely via Supabase for user progress tracking and badge achievements.

3. Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out via our official domain channels at theparkblueprint.com.
